question: Within how many days must a department pay MahaIT's Urban MahaNet invoice?

gold_grs_detail.title: Centralised payment from departments/offices for the implementation of Urban MahaNet project

product.answer: The department or office must pay MahaIT's Urban MahaNet invoice within 15 days from the date of issuance, as per the 24-12-2018 GR.
